messages:
Nora (People Ops): Quick Q — Sam booked premium economy on a 12hr international flight and used personal card, asking for reimbursement retroactively. What's the policy?
Sam (Traveler): Flight was nonstop, back-to-back meetings, couldn't tolerate economy. Booked out of pocket, saved receipt.
Ibrahim (Finance): By policy, upgrades require pre-approval from manager unless medical/ADA or longest-leg >10hrs and manager had given verbal ok. Retrospective approvals are considered case-by-case.
Olivia (Manager): I gave verbal okay during booking due to schedule. I can approve retro if Sam adds a short justification and includes my note.
Nora (People Ops): Steps: 1) Submit expense with original airfare line and separate "upgrade" line with the difference amount. 2) Attach flight itinerary, proof of purchase (card receipt), and manager approval (email or message). 3) If using miles for upgrade, no cash reimbursement — mark as personal.
Sam (Traveler): The receipt shows two charges (fare + seat upgrade fee) on my card. Can I attach both?
Ibrahim (Finance): Yes attach both. If charges were bundled, include airline's fare breakdown PDF or screenshot.
Nora (People Ops): Note: For long-haul upgrades (>8 hours) we generally allow Premium Economy if economy would cause medical or productivity issues and manager pre-approves. Business class requires stronger justification and exec approval.
Sam (Traveler): What about company-paid upgrades on the company card for shared bookings?
Olivia (Manager): For group travel, ask Travel Admin to book and charge company card. Personal upgrades should still follow approval steps.
Ibrahim (Finance): Coding: GL: Travel-Airfare, Cost Center: ENG, Project: Client-Visit-2026. If reimbursing, reimbursement will be in payroll currency using posted rate.
Nora (People Ops): If denied, company will reimburse only the lowest eligible fare. Any personal portion must be paid back or recorded as taxable benefit if charged to company.
travel-bot: Reminder - policy summary: https://intranet.redwood/travel#upgrades. Retro approvals require manager note and People Ops sign-off.
Sam (Traveler): Uploaded docs and note from Olivia. Thanks all :thumbsup:
